scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n client-tests,server-tests "npm run test:watch -w client" "npm run test:watch -w server"
